_review.method: Skimmed the probe_review.txt caption pairs across the arms. The judgement was made at the arm level -- the pattern was the same everywhere -- and applied to every run of every arm.
_review.finding: With the image, captions are well-formed English (a judgement about writing quality, NOT about whether the register is right). With the image blanked, output is mostly gibberish. Consistent with the measured 0% identical-caption rate and the collapse to 4-5 distinct strings across 500 cells in every run.
_review.criterion: prereg S7 requires captions to change 'substantially' without the image and sets no threshold; the call is the reviewer's.
